name: ScriptableObject Pattern
description: ScriptableObject 架構規則：基於 Unity 官方 'Create modular game architecture with ScriptableObjects' 電子書的最佳實踐。確保 SO 用於資料配置與共享，推薦 Event Channel、Runtime Set、Delegate Object 和 Flyweight 模式。

unity64Notes.serializeReferenceValidation: On the Unity 6.4 baseline, Unity warns when a class assigned to a [SerializeReference] field -- or ANY of that class's ancestors -- lacks [Serializable]. Treat a missing [Serializable] anywhere in the base-class chain of a [SerializeReference] target as a violation, not a style nit. This matters most for the DelegateObject pattern below, where an abstract ScriptableObject or plain abstract base defines the pluggable behaviour and concrete subclasses are assigned by reference.
unity64Notes.destroyBehaviour: Also on 6.4: Object.Destroy now invokes OnDisable on all descendants, matching DestroyImmediate. RuntimeSet implementations that rely on OnDisable to remove an object from the set no longer need manual propagation to children -- manual propagation now double-fires and should be removed.

recommendPatterns: EventChannel: 使用 ScriptableObject 作為事件中介取代 Singleton，包含 UnityAction/System.Action 委派
RuntimeSet: 使用 ScriptableObject 維護 GameObject 集合，物件在 OnEnable/OnDisable 時自動加入/移除
DelegateObject: ScriptableObject 包含可插拔行為邏輯，使用 abstract class 定義介面
Flyweight: 將共享靜態資料存放在 ScriptableObject 中，多個 GameObject 引用同一份資料
DualSerialization: ScriptableObject + JSON 混合序列化，支援 modding 和外部編輯
